definitions.gloss: weather map; weather chart; synoptic chart
definitions.explanation: A map showing atmospheric conditions over a region at a given time, including pressure systems, fronts, and other meteorological data.

examples.english: To look at the weather map.

examples.japanese: {天気図|てんきず}から{台風|たいふう}の{進路|しんろ}を{読|よ}み{取|と}る。
examples.english: To read the typhoon's path from the weather map.

examples.japanese: {理科|りか}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{天気図|てんきず}の{読|よ}み{方|かた}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned how to read weather maps in science class.

notes:
Compound of {天気|てんき} (weather) + {図|ず} (chart, map). A standard term used in meteorology, weather forecasting, and school education.

USAGE:
Weather maps are a fixture of Japanese TV weather forecasts and are taught in middle school science classes. Japanese weather maps use {等圧線|とうあつせん} (isobars), {前線|ぜんせん} (fronts), and symbols for {高気圧|こうきあつ} (high pressure) and {低気圧|ていきあつ} (low pressure). Reading weather maps is part of the standard school curriculum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天気図|てんきず}を{読|よ}む — to read a weather map
- {天気図|てんきず}の{見方|みかた} — how to read a weather map
- {地上|ちじょう}{天気図|てんきず} — surface weather map
- {天気図|てんきず}{記号|きごう} — weather map symbols

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {天気予報|てんきよほう} — weather forecast (the prediction, not the map)
- {気象図|きしょうず} — meteorological chart (more technical synonym)
- {天気|てんき} — weather (the condition itself)
